hypothesis: Replace whole-family singletonization only in the existing broad-panel large-copy guard with bounded strong-edge components as candidates for duplication-aware phylogenetic reconciliation. This may recover homologous context without retaining an entire oversized or weakly connected family.

evidence.note: Feasibility is not accuracy. All 251 eligible families were decomposed without reference labels before the complete paired reference join. No component threshold or size-bound search was performed.

candidate.eligibility: Unchanged existing large-copy predicate: broad dataset, minimum family size and maximum within-species copy count; no dataset name or reference-family identity in inference.
candidate.whole_family_deferral: Disabled; combinations rejected for first-mechanism ablation

comparisons: Matched unchanged refinement with own inferred trees
Existing completed large-only and medium-only whole-family deferral ablations
Retained sequence-only OrthoFinder comparator and other benchmarked methods, with their original execution/timing semantics
execution_order: Preserve diagnostic failures and independently verify component feasibility before committing the plan.
Implement opt-in profile, canonical bounded components, score-array validation, native CLI/API context guards and focused tests; preserve default output and existing experimental policies.
Finish or recover existing fresh-HMM cap trials and branch ablations; independently admit complete branch vectors before submitting the next inference round. Do not duplicate successful inference.

Freeze tested source, input identities, runtime, scoring and resource plan before one cached-graph component ablation with own inferred trees. Verify narrow-panel inactivity before reusing matched outputs.
Compare the full endpoint vector; if broadly promising, freeze the candidate for fresh full-pipeline evaluation and overlap-audited unexposed confirmation that exercises the affected branch.

resources.policy: Leave unrelated jobs untouched; shared-host timing confounding and cached versus fresh scopes remain explicit.

selection.rule: Report per-endpoint changes and Pareto tradeoffs, not mean-only selection. Retain failed or missing cells honestly. No default promotion without reproducible broad support and appropriate unexposed confirmation.
selection.fas: Unseeded point differences are descriptive; account for sampling variability before claiming improvements.
selection.fallback: If the mechanism fails the screen, reject default promotion and diagnose family/alignment and duplication evidence before any bounded follow-up; do not increase caps or exclude reference families to hide regressions.

limitations: Components establish candidate context, not orthology or predicted accuracy.
Sequence-length summaries are not alignment coherence.
TreeFam is supporting evidence; incomplete archival provenance is nonblocking.
Large-copy behavior is inactive on narrow panels, so unchanged OrthoBench or Three Kingdoms scores would not validate this branch.
